Ewave Extended Cart
=====================

confirmation-popup.js

Option | Type | Default | Description
------ | ---- | ------- | -----------
continueButton | string | '[data-role="continue-button"]' | Selector for button Continue
modalConfig |  | object |  | Config for modal widget
 | modalClass | string | 'confirmation-popup' | Class for confirmation popup.
 | buttons | array | [] | Array with buttons for popup
 
 The full list of settings for the modal widget can be viewed [here](https://devdocs.magento.com/guides/v2.2/javascript-dev-guide/widgets/widget_modal.html)
 
 ajax-cart.js
 
 Option | Type | Default | Description
 ------ | ---- | ------- | -----------
form | string | '#form-validate' | Selector for element form.
inputQty | string | '.input-text.qty' | Selector for input element.
loader | string | '.cart-container' | Selector for loader container.
loaderConfig | object | {} | Config for loader widget.

The full list of setting for the loader widget can be viewed [here](https://devdocs.magento.com/guides/v2.2/javascript-dev-guide/widgets/widget_loader.html)
